description: This file defines the class PlatformDataIntegrityException, a custom exception extending AbstractPlatformException, used for signaling data integrity problems within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: PlatformDataIntegrityException
classes.description: A RuntimeException used for signaling data integrity issues due to state-modifying actions.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message code, user message, and optional arguments.

methods.description: Returns the parameter name associated with the data integrity problem, if any.
